# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 34 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 37 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_034_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 34

**1** Jesus said: "When one blind person leads another, they both fall into a ditch."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "When" — renders the conditional as temporal
- "Ditch" — "pit" rendered as a ditch; slightly less dire

---
